summary: Improve banking service workflows, payment enquiry handoffs, and complaint follow-up. Explore the five-day foundation course and its practical outline.
lede: Banking operations training helps customer-facing staff and supervisors improve how service requests, payment enquiries and complaints move between teams. It covers mapping customer journeys and workflows, clarifying payment handoffs, checking service controls, tracking complaints and using service measures to prepare operational reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who handle or oversee customer-facing banking workflows, service requests, payment enquiries, and operational reporting.
prerequisites: Foundation-level course. No specialist banking operations experience is assumed; coding is not required.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
